description: EvolitY - Horaires théoriques de transport public is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by évolitY. Horaires théoriques de transport public du réseau évolitY de l'Agglomération du Pays de Montbéliard - période du 01 Janvier 2026 au 12 juillet 2026. Coverage: évolitY. The portal shows the English title as "EvolitY - Theoretical timetables for public transport" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is évolitY. Its keywords include montbeliard, evolity, bus, transport-public. The listing shows 2 download or service links in SIRI, ZIP. The listing shows 2026-07-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
